remarks_1999: Double Downtown Gallery label. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946" [note of inscription 2]. Whitney Archive indicates "initials . . . Abstract trees." Abiquiú Notebooks notes inscription 2. Backing inscription, Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1923. Dated 1922 on basis of inclusion in 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition; pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 15. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A twisting, dark brown maple tree with sparse clusters of red leaves stands to the left of a dark green cedar with a triangular top. A tree with a white trunk and yellow leaves is visible to the left of the maple. Overhear, dark, swirling gray and blue clouds threaten a storm.
